Welcome aboard, {name}. The lanterns are lit and the water is still. Take your time with every door.
Open the shutters and look out at the water. Someone made this for you, and thought of you the whole time.
Tea first, everything else after. Pour something warm, {name}, and sit with it for a minute.
One small light is enough to find your way. This one is for you.
Some things are kept for exactly the right moment. This was one of them.
If the world ever feels too deep, hold on to the people who would swim out after you. You have more of them than you think.
Roll the blind up. The evening has changed colour while you were busy. Notice it.
A letter, just for you. It says what it always says: I am glad you exist.
Something is cooking behind this hatch. Home smells different to everyone. What does yours smell like, {name}?
Lift the lid. Steam, and the first good thing of the week.
A basket of small things that were good today. Count yours before you sleep. There are more than three.
Throw the net out wide. Most of what we miss later is ordinary. Pay attention to today, {name}.
Slide it open. Cold air at last. Winter is on its way, and so are good things.
Draw the curtain back. You are exactly where you should be.
Every drawer holds something you forgot you loved. Go and find yours.
A little shelf to rest your cup on. Sit here a moment. You do not have to be doing anything.
Whichever way you turn, there is a way back to the people who love you, {name}.
A secret way down, and at the bottom, the spare blankets. There is always something warm tucked away.
Step out onto the upper deck. Look how far you can see. You earned the climb.
Slide the shutter aside. The mist is lifting. Somewhere across the water, someone is singing.
Crack one open on a cold night and it still tastes like summer. Keep a little summer for yourself.
A little boat, just big enough for a secret. Here it is: I am proud of you.
A message in a bottle: you were thought of long before you opened this, {name}.
The star is lit. Thank you for opening every door. Merry Christmas, {name}.
